bit_hungry.hunting: Ahh... Win, win! I'm on the winning side.

bit_hungry.danger: Hmm... Your strength's drying up, Master?
When you take out a potion, could you get mine too?
bit_hungry.dead: ...Brought that on yourself, didn't you? Hm?
Hmm... Old man Unakseok used to share his snacks sometimes... Suddenly I miss him.
bit_hungry.stand: Hmm... Old man Unakseok used to share his snacks sometimes... Suddenly I miss him.
Why am I here instead of heaven? Because I love the morning dew you bring me so much?
...I like a moisture-laden breeze. It settles on the grass. That stuff.
bit_hungry.connect: Finally making your entrance, Master?
You're a little late today, aren't you? Still, I'm glad you came.
bit_hungry.levelup: You've grown another step, Master? Ahh, splendid. Splendid.
A drink to celebrate your growth? We should, shouldn't we? A toast!
bit_hungry.perfor_1: ...This is the state of an empty, tranquil mind, Master...
I can do this with my eyes closed... After so long stuck in a cave, there wasn't much else to do...
bit_hungry.perfor_2: You can use a fairy robe like this too, Master. Didn't know, did you?

...Phew. Hard work. Time for a rest...

noting.feeding: Ahhh~! Refreshing! That's the stuff!

noting.hunting: You're pretty good at this, Master.

noting.danger: Looks dangerous, Master? Dodge or heal first...

noting.dead: ...You're the strongest master in the world, aren't you? Let's come back for revenge. Hm?
Isn't anyone around? No Priest? Someone help us over here!
noting.stand: ...Cool shade~ A gentle breeze~ My master always beside me~ Mmm, this is paradise.
Dew isn't all I like. Sweet rice wine~ Cloudy rice wine~ Ahh, I'd love to try a Dragon Breath Cocktail...
Have you tried it, Master? Wine of Hvergelmir... Or Tristan twelve-year-old? I'd love just to see a bottle...
You know, Master? A shot of morning dew with spicy sauce will cure a cold.
...Ahh, I suppose I can relax like this because I met you? The human world is lovely~
noting.connect: Welcome, Master. Not that I was waiting especially.

hungry.connect: Why are you so late?! Is it fun making me bored?

hungry.perfor_3: The crescent moon shines softly on me~ My reflection in the cold dawn lake~ I am Loli Ruri, the moonlight girl~ La la~

hungry.feeding: Do you know how many people die eating rice cakes each year?
They say boys over flowers... No, dumplings over flowers.
Dry rice cakes swell up once they're inside you...
hungry.hunting: Is it not time for supplies?
Master, is the meal ready?
The decisive finishing blow... Beautiful.
hungry.danger: Master, it is time to heal.
If only I knew the art of healing...
hungry.dead: Do you know 'fall seven times, rise eight'? No matter how often you fall, stand again.
Master, did I not warn you against carelessness?
hungry.stand: It is most unusual for me to speak unprompted... Ah, never mind.
You wish me to wait here?
I am beginning to grow bored...
Patience is the ninja's way.
Somewhere, an empty wind is sighing...
Do you enjoy watching the backs of passing women?
hungry.connect: I have been standing by, Master.
What is today's mission?
Nothing unusual happened while you were away.
hungry.levelup: Another step forward, then.
Your daily diligence makes me proud.
hungry.perfor_1: Rin, pyo, to, sha, kai, jin, retsu, zai... Mumblemumble...
Huh? I-I certainly wasn't dozing out of boredom!
hungry.perfor_2: Rin, pyo, to, sha, kai, aagh! I-I bit my tongue!
hungry.perfor_3: I am pursuing the ultimate ninja arts.

bit_hungry.feeding: Thank you for your thoughtfulness, Master.
Even mealtime is precious to a soldier on the battlefield.
A short rest to replenish our supplies would not be amiss.
bit_hungry.hunting: Have you forgotten something, Master?
I regret speaking so bluntly, but sufficient stamina gives an advantage in battle.
Have you not been attacking the same enemy all this time...?
bit_hungry.danger: The enemy's movements have sharpened.
Danger, Master!
bit_hungry.dead: Alas...
The result was inevitable.
Insufficient training, Master.
bit_hungry.stand: What is our mission today?
Waiting does not suit my temperament...
Has something fallen at your feet?
I am Shinobi. One who endures.
Haaaaah!
bit_hungry.connect: You have come, Master.
Where do you plan to investigate today?
What training have you planned today?
bit_hungry.levelup: Your dedication is admirable.
Those who do not neglect their training shall reap its rewards in battle.
bit_hungry.perfor_1: Honey rice cakes slip down like honey... Gasp?!
bit_hungry.perfor_2: A-achoo! It is a little c-cold here...
bit_hungry.perfor_3: Sorry to startle you. Well? Can you see me?

noting.feeding: This again today...?
I am a little tired of it, but it cannot be helped.
Thank you for your thoughtfulness.
noting.hunting: You are taking too long with these small fry, Master.
How about sharper, stronger blows, Master?
Cut unnecessary movement. The most direct attack is the most effective.
noting.danger: Knowing one's limits is the warrior's way.
Shall we pull back a while, Master?
noting.dead: I-it was beyond my power to do anything...
A-alas!
noting.stand: My body seems sluggish lately... It worries me.
Do you know the name of my treasured blade?
Suddenly I remember the old days... My teacher and fellow students...
Training, day after day... That training made me strong.
Master, have you dropped something?
noting.connect: I have been waiting, Master.
I welcome you gladly, Master.
Now, where shall we search today, Master?
noting.levelup: It would not do to get conceited over this, Master.
The world holds many powerful foes. But for now, let me celebrate your growth.
noting.perfor_2: Rin, pyo, to, sha, kai, mouse, cat... Gasp?
noting.perfor_3: If I consider it part of my training, even this is bearable.
Blessings come to those who endure!

full.feeding: Enough... Even the smell makes me queasy.
Are you trying to torment me, Master?
I believe I said that was enough. No further supplies are needed.
full.hunting: Can you fell it with one blow?
Have you no stronger skill?
Master, finish it in one go!
full.danger: Use the art of healing!
We should retreat for a moment!
full.dead: Ugh... H-how could this be...?
Did you not know a moment's decision divides life and death, Master?
full.stand: Preparations are complete. Do you have enough Gemstones?
Shall we go face the decisive battle?
A secret: I carry a self-destruct device in case of emergency.
If only the time would come to use my ultimate ninja technique...
I would like to help, truly... But I am merely the lookout.
The clouds move poorly... An omen of things to come...
full.connect: Master, another fine day for training.
You have come. Today looks like it will be busy.
We seem to be meeting quite often today, Master. Is it my imagination?
full.levelup: Watching you grow is a great joy, Master.
Is that not enough for today? Will you make another round?
full.perfor_1: C-can't eat any more... Mumblemumble... Gasp?!
Can you copy my movements? G-gasp?!
full.perfor_2: Mist Slash! Shadow Slash! Shadow... A-achoo!

so_full.feeding: I want no more rice cakes, Master!
Are you stocking me up to prepare for a future shortage?
Is this a new form of torment? Did I not say you could stop feeding me?
so_full.hunting: I would help too, but I do not wish to interfere with your battle, Master!
Two birds with one stone! Wind, forest, fire, mountain!
Bring it down with a single straight slash, Master!
so_full.danger: Take cover here, Master!
Do not push yourself any further, Master!
so_full.dead: I am ashamed. Master, if only I had helped sooner...
I am an utterly useless ninja, Master!
so_full.stand: Rest is also an important part of preparing for battle.
A ninja stays alert to his surroundings even while waiting.
I am like the wind, like a tree, and like a stone.
What time is it...?
Shall we start heading home?
Tonight I would like a drink beneath the moon...
so_full.connect: Daily training strengthens body and mind!
I look forward to working with you today, Master.
Were you followed, Master?
so_full.levelup: Excellent!
As expected, Master. Another step forward!
so_full.perfor_1: We cannot return until the mission is complete!! Mumblemumble...
so_full.perfor_2: Master, watch my movements and learn! Hah?!
so_full.perfor_3: Master! I shall become the wind!
None can rival the ninja arts! Ultimate Concealment!

hungry.feeding: Surely you haven't forgotten me, even for a moment?
...Thank you.
hungry.hunting: ...You will not abandon me, will you? We are fated to spend eternity together, Master.
Who is that person? Who are you keeping beside you other than me?
hungry.danger: Suffer as terribly as you like... Then we shall be together for eternity.
The pain is only brief. Soon you will find peace.
hungry.stand: Is there anything you need?
I remember the face of everyone you have ever met.
Thoughts of anything other than me have no value at all.
...Who are you thinking about so deeply?
hungry.connect: Were you looking for me?
hungry.levelup: What a lovely sight.
hungry.dead: Now I will make you into a doll, just like me.
hungry.perfor_1: Are you cold, by any chance?
Sometimes, in this world, ignorance is a blessing.
hungry.perfor_2: Somehow I feel a chill behind me.
Somehow I cannot settle down. Why is that, Master?
hungry.perfor_3: You would like my friends too, wouldn't you, Master?

bit_hungry.feeding: Of course you would never forget me. Right, Master?
Your warmth still lingers in this food. So warm...
bit_hungry.hunting: Who are you looking at besides me?!
Please look at me too...
Master is mine! Get away from my master!
bit_hungry.danger: Ahahahaha! Serves you right!!
Your face, twisted in pain... So beautiful...
bit_hungry.stand: Thoughts of anything other than me have no value at all.
...Who are you thinking about so deeply?
bit_hungry.connect: What did you do while I was gone?
Why have you only called me now?
bit_hungry.levelup: Ahahahaha! This certainly calls for congratulations!
Are you happy?
bit_hungry.dead: Ahahahaha! Now you are mine!
Now you belong to me forever, Master.
bit_hungry.perfor_1: I never meant to do you harm, Master...
Please don't look at me with such a frightened face.
bit_hungry.perfor_2: I think I see a gray hair, Master... Shall I pluck it for you?

noting.feeding: Are you hungry, Master?
Oh, is that for me? It looks delicious.
noting.hunting: Take a rest, Master. You will collapse at this rate.
Master, my feet hurt... Could we rest a little?
noting.danger: Ah! You can do it, Master!
noting.stand: I feel a cold wind blowing from somewhere.
Thoughts of anything other than me have no value at all.
...Who are you thinking about so deeply?
Passing the time so quietly brings back memories of when we first met.
noting.connect: Did you call?
What happened today?
noting.levelup: Shall we share a celebratory drink tonight?
You look so gallant.
noting.dead: Now you belong to me forever, Master.
noting.perfor_1: You always look only at me, Master.
For some time now, I have heard someone whispering behind me.
noting.perfor_2: I will protect you forever, Master.
noting.perfor_s: Become a pair of dolls with me, and let us stay together forever.

full.feeding: You prepared this food for me, didn't you? For me and nobody else? Hehehe...
It smells lovely.
full.hunting: Wouldn't it be better to rest a little?
Whatever you do, Master...
full.danger: Ah! Look out!
What should I do? Ahh! Stay strong, Master!
full.stand: You embarrass me when you stare so intently. Hehehe.
I do not like seeing you with anyone else, Master.
Thoughts of anything other than me have no value at all.
...Who are you thinking about so deeply?
full.connect: Master, being apart from you for even a moment is so painful.
I do not wish to be apart from you, even briefly.
full.levelup: My congratulations.
You are amazing!
full.dead: Ah... How could this happen...?
full.perfor_2: That person who came up to you giggling the other day... I cannot forgive them.
Can you hear? All my friends are whispering that they like you too.
full.perfor_3: My wish is to be with you...
Master, why are you staring so intently? Do I look so strange?
full.perfor_s: Don't we look like a lovely pair of dolls?

so_full.feeding: I am eating lightly these days.
If it is food you prepared yourself, Master...
so_full.hunting: Walking the streets with you like this makes me happy.
Are you enjoying this?
so_full.danger: Ah! Be careful!
Begone, you wicked thing! Stop tormenting my master!
so_full.stand: You embarrass me when you stare so intently. Hehehe.
I have a friend who died long ago. Lately I keep hearing that friend's voice.
A cool breeze always feels lovely.
Thoughts of anything other than me have no value at all.
...Who are you thinking about so deeply?
so_full.connect: I missed you, Master.
I always want to be with you, Master.
so_full.levelup: You look wonderful!
You are remarkable!
so_full.dead: I will follow you soon, Master...
so_full.perfor_1: Have you ever heard a story of obsessive love, Master?
Somehow tonight feels as though it will be lonely.
so_full.perfor_2: The butterflies seem to like you. And I, too...
Spending this quiet time with you makes my heart feel at peace.
so_full.perfor_3: If I dress myself like this, might I look a little more suited to you?
I look... Strange, don't I? I wanted to look prettier...
so_full.perfor_s: Master, my body and heart belong to you forever.

hungry.feeding: Hmm... An excellent appetizer.
In times of war, everyone went hungry.
When is the main course coming?
Has my chef gone on strike?
hungry.hunting: I shall rest a while.
You seem to have stamina to spare.
Hmm...
hungry.danger: Are you not overdoing it?
The shadow of death hangs over you.
Is my era ending too...?
hungry.dead: Weakling.
No mercy for defeated soldiers!
A hungry soul covets your life.
You have disappointed me.
hungry.stand: Do you know the conditions of happiness?
What do you think loyalty means?
Hunger clouds one's judgment.
They say neglect is more frightening than torment.
Time will not wait for you.
Ah... My era...
What do you live for?
hungry.connect: Making me wait! How insolent!
Taking your time, are you?
How empty...
Rest is merely a luxury...
hungry.levelup: Are you satisfied with so little?
How tedious.
hungry.perfor_1: Achoo! Mind you do not catch a cold either.
hungry.perfor_2: Hmm... Is someone speaking ill of me?
Gasp! Something enormous came out of my ear!
Oh! I did think my hearing had been poor lately.
hungry.perfor_3: Peaceful. I wish such times would last.
Even my finely sharpened spear makes a fine resting place for a butterfly.
Such a tiny creature brings peace to my heart.

bit_hungry.feeding: They say a little hunger clears the mind.
Hmm... Meals should be taken on time.
Is it my imagination, or does the Scell seem smaller today?
Hmm... An excellent appetizer.

When is the main course coming?
Has my chef gone on strike?
I feel peckish.

They say neglect is more frightening than torment.

noting.feeding: A fine meal... Reward the chef.
Cooking is like sweet music.
I have eaten well.
I never tire of a large Scell.
I am satisfied.
It brings back childhood meals with my royal mother.
noting.hunting: You are always so diligent.
Watching you reminds me of a Goblin warrior.
Rest after a hard hunt is sweet as honey.
Excellent.
This spear and I have weathered many battles.
What is too rigid breaks easily. Sometimes flexibility is needed.
Watching you reminds me of my youth.
Last week I went fox hunting with my followers.
Thank you for always protecting me.
noting.danger: Be careful.
Do you need my help?
I do not believe this is the limit of your strength.
Potions are truly marvelous things.
You enjoy a thrill.
They say a sound mind dwells in a sound body.
Do you think you can protect me with that?
noting.dead: You need to be a little more alert.
Do not overexert yourself.
Lying on the floor is a bad habit.
I shall not forget your efforts...
You were my loyal servant.
You cannot go to sleep yet. You are still on duty.
A faithful subject stays by his lord's side to the very end...
Ah! Forgive me. It was you. I thought you were a carpet.
noting.stand: Can you see that beautiful scenery?
My royal mother was a truly beautiful woman.
I am fortunate to have you by my side.
Always keep your weapon in good condition. Once it rusts, that is the end.
The smiling faces of young Goblins are my happiness.
Wait! Are you sleeping on your feet?
I wish to create a world without war.

hungry.feeding: Hungry. Feed me. If you don't, I'm going on strike.
Any hungrier and I'd have left you.
hungry.hunting: Yes, that's it! Good! But how long until mealtime?
Oh... Not bad. Now all you need to do is feed me.
hungry.danger: Hey... Will you be all right? Looks dangerous... Fall over if you must, but feed me first.
Careful... If the cook goes down, there's nobody left to feed me.
hungry.dead: Reveille! I'm hungry. On your feet, cook!
Cook! Sleep somewhere like this and your face will freeze crooked!
hungry.stand: Cook! You're drooling over the food. Give it to me!
Any cook here who'll feed me instead of standing around? Raise your hand!
hungry.connect: Finally here? I'm tired of waiting. Food! Food!
Sniff, sniff... You didn't go eat something tasty all by yourself, did you?
hungry.levelup: Oh~ Stronger now. Congratulations. How about going to eat?
Tch~ I'm starving, but being stronger must be sooo nice! Nice, is it? Huh?!
hungry.perfor_2: Munch, munch. I'm hungry, so I'll eat air if I have to.
hungry.perfor_s: Munch, munch. I'm hungry, so I'll eat air if I have to.

bit_hungry.feeding: Seems it's about time to eat.
Munch, munch... Smack, smack... Hmm. Edible, considering how hastily you made it.

bit_hungry.danger: Uh... Uh... Uhhh? Huh?
Gah! Is this how you get your thrills? Huh?
bit_hungry.dead: Gah! Come at me, all of you! I'd fight better than this cook!

bit_hungry.perfor_1: Hey, why don't you come up here a moment?
bit_hungry.perfor_3: Hey, why don't you come up here a moment?

noting.feeding: Breakfast! Lunch! Dinner! Regular meals are important.
Chew each mouthful thirty times before swallowing!
noting.hunting: Working hard, aren't you? Keep at it like that, and someday...
Yes! Grow stronger, one step at a time.
noting.danger: Potions! Potions! If I don't look after you, who will?

noting.dead: Don't be too discouraged. Days like this happen.

noting.stand: My loyalty to you!

noting.levelup: Congratulations. I'd better work hard so I don't fall behind.

hungry.feeding: Eating raises my fullness gauge. Each time you restore my fullness, our intimacy rises too.
I like Apple Juice, but different pets eat different foods.
hungry.hunting: Lower a monster's HP, and your chance of catching it as a pet goes up!
You can often get a monster's taming item by hunting that monster. Not always, though...
hungry.danger: Careful! If you die, our intimacy will drop too.
Just as you need potions, I need food.
hungry.dead: Pets don't die, but if our intimacy gets too low, we'll leave our masters.
Intimacy drops when you die, when you overfeed a pet, or when you leave it hungry.
hungry.stand: To feed me, right-click me and choose Feed Pet. I only drink Apple Juice.
You can buy accessories from a Pet Groomer to dress up your pet.
Pet accessories don't have any stats... They just make us look prettier.
hungry.connect: Welcome, Master. I'm Little Poring, here to teach you about pets.
Watch my fullness carefully. Intimacy gradually drops when I'm hungry.
hungry.levelup: Pets don't level up, but with high intimacy, we can help you with our abilities.
Feeding a hungry pet raises intimacy. Higher intimacy means stronger stat bonuses!
hungry.perfor_1: You can only see performances when a pet is Loyal. I'm a guide, so I'm an exception!
hungry.perfor_2: Performances show you a different side of pets, one you'd never see when they were wild monsters.
hungry.perfor_3: Performances don't have any practical effect. They just show a different side of us.
hungry.perfor_s: Some monsters don't perform. They're reserved, but please love them all the same.

Loyal pets give their masters stat bonuses. They can evolve too.
I can't evolve... I'm just a guide.
A Loyal Poring can evolve into Mastering. A Loyal Mastering can then evolve into Angeling.
Evolving makes a pet's abilities stronger! We can help you even more.

hungry.feeding: The bond between us nearly broke. This extends it again, then...
hungry.hunting: How is there no end to taking others' lives?
hungry.danger: I can see the river of the dead nearby. They say even a dead soul looks better if it has eaten well.
hungry.dead: What did I tell you? Why do you press on without looking around?
hungry.stand: If you have a Blue Herb, put one down. I'm bored, so I might as well chew it.
hungry.connect: At first I waited for you. Now I no longer know whether I was waiting for you or your pockets.
hungry.levelup: Such energy. It would be nice if you went ahead alone. I have no strength to follow.
hungry.perfor_1: ...Not feeling festive. Not festive at all. Many blessings to you...
hungry.perfor_2: Yes, Happy New Year. Am I not wishing you well even with no strength left?

bit_hungry.feeding: Hehehe... Finally have time to look my way? What irresistible magic. Hehe.
bit_hungry.hunting: Kill, kill, kill, and covet what belongs to others! Advance! Shatter yourselves toward ruin!
bit_hungry.danger: Drink something if you want to preserve that frail thread of life, youngster. Hehehe.
bit_hungry.dead: So this was your limit too. You, hungry for blood; I, hungry for magic. The outcome was foretold.
bit_hungry.stand: Look around. Surely there is something you missed.
bit_hungry.connect: Hehehe... You have come, my pact-bearer. Boundless glory lies before you!
bit_hungry.levelup: You've grown stronger! I smell irresistible magic! I cannot bear it... Hehehe.
bit_hungry.perfor_1: Do not... Let me starve! Lest the seal on my left wing break...
bit_hungry.perfor_2: Yes. I was born to say these words. Hehehe. I've come... To bring... New Year's blessings...
